1.w: For the music director, according to the tune of “Lilies”; by the Korahites, a well-written poem, a love song. My heart is stirred by a beautiful song. I say, “I have composed this special song for the king; my tongue is as skilled as the stylus of an experienced scribe.”

2.w: You are the most handsome of all men. You speak in an impressive and fitting manner. For this reason God grants you continual blessings.

3.w: Strap your sword to your thigh, O warrior. Appear in your majestic splendor.

4.w: Appear in your majesty and be victorious. Ride forth for the sake of what is right, on behalf of justice. Then your right hand will accomplish mighty acts.

5.w: Your arrows are sharp and penetrate the hearts of the king’s enemies. Nations fall at your feet.

6.w: Your throne, O God, is permanent. The scepter of your kingdom is a scepter of justice.

7.w: You love justice and hate evil. For this reason God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of joy, elevating you above your companions.

8.w: All your garments are perfumed with myrrh, aloes, and cassia. From the luxurious palaces comes the music of stringed instruments that makes you happy.

9.w: Princesses are among your honored women. Your bride stands at your right hand, wearing jewelry made with gold from Ophir.

10.w: Listen, O princess. Observe and pay attention! Forget your homeland and your family.

11.w: Then the king will be attracted by your beauty. After all, he is your master. Submit to him.

12.w: Rich people from Tyre will seek your favor by bringing a gift.

13.w: The princess looks absolutely magnificent, decked out in pearls and clothed in a brocade trimmed with gold.

14.w: In embroidered robes she is escorted to the king. Her attendants, the maidens of honor who follow her, are led before you.

15.w: They are bubbling with joy as they walk in procession and enter the royal palace.

16.w: Your sons will carry on the dynasty of your ancestors; you will make them princes throughout the land.

17.w: I will proclaim your greatness through the coming years, then the nations will praise you forever.
